components: markymark-parser/src/extract.rs (regex-based extraction updated for arena-backed outputs)
markymark-parser/src/types/ (elements, links, blocks, frontmatter, xml - arena-backed element types)
markymark-index/src/realm.rs (RealmIndex: multi-document workspace, hybrid arena with ResolvedHeading/ResolvedBlock, slug_to_headings, block_to_location preserving duplicate IDs, tag_to_docs)
markymark-index/benches/memory.rs (criterion benchmarks: index/reparse/real_corpus/synthetic_scale, CountingAllocator for alloc metrics)
markymark-index/src/bench_config.rs (sample/doc tier env parsing for benchmark control)
markymark-index/src/bench_corpus.rs (mixed-size synthetic corpus generation for scale tests)
markymark-index/src/bench_report.rs (criterion estimate parsing + markdown report rendering)
markymark-index/src/bin/bench_roi_report.rs (tiered benchmark orchestration and ROI report writer)
markymark-lsp/src/state.rs (ServerState: document management, diagnostics, rename, refs)
markymark-mcp/src/runtime_engine.rs (MCP RuntimeEngine: startup indexing, CoreEngine impl)
tests: markymark-lsp/tests/ (11 files: capabilities, completion_*, diagnostics, hover, rename, etc.)
markymark-cli/tests/ (cli_args, smoke_lsp, smoke_mcp, lsp_methods, mcp_methods, alignment, bench)

rustModules: Arena helpers in markymark-core/src/arena.rs for cross-crate shared allocator behavior
Element types in markymark-parser/src/types/ (elements, links, blocks, frontmatter, xml submodules)
Parser AST construction and arena ownership in markymark-parser/src/ast.rs
MCP DTOs in markymark-mcp/src/dto.rs, resources in src/resources.rs
Integration tests in crate tests/ dirs are standalone crates (no mod.rs needed)

rust: CoreEngine trait in core, transport crates are thin adapters
Drop read lock before async calls (deadlock prevention)
Single-pass stack tokenizer for XML extraction
Deterministic sort by URI then range for stable output
Range containment for nested XML document symbols
Use arena_ref() helper to avoid duplicated unsafe transmute logic
extract_list_items returns Vec<&ListItem> (refs not clones) to avoid ArenaHashMap::clone SIGSEGV
Arena empty slice: bumpalo Vec::new_in(arena).into_bump_slice() not &[] (UAF risk)
Tier benchmark controls via MARKYMARK_BENCH_SAMPLES and MARKYMARK_BENCH_DOC_TIER to separate quick iteration from scale validation
Benchmark ROI automation via bench_roi_report binary that runs benches, parses criterion estimates.json, and emits docs/benchmarks report artifacts
codeStyle.bash: set -euo pipefail, jq for JSON, case statements for file extension matching

codePatterns: DocumentArena wrapper preferred over raw Bump for per-document arenas (Debug, capacity)
ArenaHashMap is !Send (Bump:!Sync); parser types can use it, index types must use std HashMap
Self-referential arena: struct owns Bump + stores refs as static; doc_arena_ptr() for ownership transfer
